title: Replace the inline membership check with assertMember()

groundTruth.description: assertMember only returns a boolean; its result is ignored, so non-members delete notes. The name suggests a check that never denies.
groundTruth.witness: witness.spec.ts › an outsider can delete a note although assertMember is called
